lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生、年末、本当、お疲れ様、本当に。
lines.en: Teacher — year-end has been so much work. Really, thank you.
lines.style: Soft, genuine opening. A beat of real warmth before speaking. Quiet sincerity, not performing. Steady pace that lands on the gratitude without rushing it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment meeting warmth. Brief, genuine. A small smile audible in the voice. The kind of response that says 'I see you' without over-explaining.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 一年、本当、長かった、本当に。
lines.style: Reflective, not complaining. A small exhale mid-sentence. Looking back with quiet affection for surviving it. Slight trailing warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.style: Steady, genuine recognition. No patronizing edge. A teacher's careful warmth — acknowledging without over-praising. Direct eye-contact level tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Soft, underneath-the-surface sincerity. Not effusive. The kind of quiet gratitude that costs something to say out loud. Slight catch before 'always.'

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: You're a precious student to me. Truly.
lines.style: Tender without sentimentality. A teacher allowing herself to say something she means. Slow, careful, each word deliberate. Warmth that comes from years of knowing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: From here on out, yes? Really.
lines.style: A small promise in the voice. Soft, forward-looking. Not goodbye — continuation. Warmth that reaches toward the future. Slight upward lilt on 'yes,' settling on the final word.
